dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The five most prominent 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit a high-contrast gradient transition from the dark charcoal exterior base to a light-grey and white serrated perimeter; the inner boundaries of these rings transition back to the darker base intensity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid white pixel clusters concentrated on the anterior dorsal surface and scattered among the larger annuli on the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal region form an elongated scalene triangle; a secondary group of four high-intensity blobs creates a small irregular quadrilateral posterior to the flipper insertion.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct transition from large-scale ringed topography to a high-density stippled pattern of small dark spots occurs on the dorsal neck and head region.
